newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: RAILWAY FIRM POSTS PROFIT FOR H1 97.
newsitem.headline: RAILWAY FIRM POSTS PROFIT FOR H1 97.

text.p: Lithuania's state-owned railway firm Lietuvos Gelezinkeliai said on Thursday that it ended the first half of 1997 with 5.6 million litas pre-tax profit after posting 5.05 million litas losses in the first half of 1996.

The company said in a statement that its losses from passenger transportation have increased to 59.8 million litas in the first half of 1997 from 59.1 million litas IN losses in the same period in 1996.

"The company's profit stemmed from cargo transportation and it covered the losses from passenger transportation," Algimantas Misiunas, the head of the firm's corporation planning division, told Reuters.
Misiunas declined to say the profit figures for cargo transportation.
The company reported 5.52 million litas losses for all of 1996.
The statement said that the revenues of Lietuvos Gelezinkeliai rose to 317.47 million litas in the first six month of the year from 282.89 million litas in the same period in 1996.
The statement also said that the firm transported 14.19 million tonnes of cargoes in the first half of 1997 compared to 12.63 million tonnes in the same period last year.
In the first six months of the year 12.35 million tonnes in cargoes were carried on international routes and 1.83 million tonnes on domestic routes, the statement said.
The figures for the corresponding period in 1996 were 10.93 million tonnes and 1.7 million tonnes respectively, the statement added.
The statement also said that the company has reduced its cargo transportation prices but provided no concrete figures.
